consequence.statement: The cilium-dbg status --verbose command output structure has changed. Health data from non-leaf components now appears under a reporter leaf, and branches are sorted by fully qualified health status identifier. Scripts or monitoring tools that parse this output may need updates to handle the new format.

original.statement: The cilium-dbg status --verbose command output format changed: health data from non-leaf components now appears under a reporter leaf, and health data tree branches are now sorted by fully qualified health status identifier.

decision.reason: [ev-dc0997efed20] says only that the health data from `cilium-dbg status --verbose` may now be shown under a `reporter` leaf and that tree branches are now sorted by the fully qualified health status identifier. It does not say that anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured. So behavior-change (review) is the right kind, and an action-eligible kind would claim more than the evidence supports. The proposed statement's note that parsers 'may need updates' is worded as a possibility, so it fits a review-level consequence. The evidence doesn't settle whether severity should be medium or low.
